python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for j,(x,c) in enumerate(zip(items[90:95],['ь','ь','ьь','ь','ъъ']),91):
 answers.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):s for i,s in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes' if j in [93,95] else 'no',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers: f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(answers)==len(items)
for x,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert x['item_id']==a['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(x['slots'])}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(c in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for c in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(c in ['high','low'] for c in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(c for a in answers for c in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items;',sum(counts.values()),'slots')
print(dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
PY
